## US-10-04 spec-compliance review, round 1 (`main...646e3925`)

All 8 acceptance criteria are evidenced by passing tests, and the story's out-of-scope items are respected. But the new answer form breaks adding in a way I saw happen against the real model. Two items are blocking. cargo test --workspace green on a copy of 646e3925 (221 + 468 + 91). TC-10-19 hand run against gemma4:e4b: date 95 %, every field 91 % (the implementer reported 98 % / 95 %).
